frequency_question: What proportion of major executive nominations achieve Senate floor confirmation within approximately seven weeks of formal submission?
membership_rule: Includes all formal nominations to cabinet-level and major statutory agency head positions (such as FDA, EPA, CDC) submitted to the U.S. Senate since 2017. Excludes judicial nominations and part-time board/commission members.
coverage_note: 10 named major health agency/department nominations; believed to represent nearly 100% of confirmed principal health leadership nominees over the sampled periods who reached a vote, though withdrawn or stalled nominations occur rarely.
known_gaps: Does not fully capture nominees who were withdrawn before a formal committee vote due to anticipated failure, though historical rates of successful confirmation among actually submitted cabinet/agency heads are exceptionally high once formally processed.
validity_reason: Base rate tied to general Senate confirmation dynamics for executive branch nominees, which remain relatively stable across congressional cycles barring extreme polarization or majority shifts.
